text:
Ryan Winterton scored in San Jose on Saturday, his third goal of the season, and he is slowly becoming a regular in Seattle. He has seven points in 20 games at about 13 minutes a night, already close to the 18 he managed in 68 games last season.

Our numbers like the process more than the line. Seattle is about four points better on five-on-five expected goals with him on than without (expected goals measure the quality of chances), on a team that is badly under water, and he has three goals on 4.7 expected, so a couple more should come. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him in the 81st percentile for chances in front of the net, though he rarely carries the puck in (33% of entries), so his line works off dump-ins and the forecheck. Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he played with weaker teammates than most. A third-round pick by the Kraken in 2021, he is 23. Our range has him around 13 goals.
